from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class StatutoryReserveRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record of the statutory surplus reserve found in one document."""
    company: Literal["洋河股份"] = Field(description="The company name specified in the task")
    report_date: str = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period as stated in the document (e.g., '2022-03-31')")
    line_item_name: str = Field(description="The exact name of the balance sheet item as written (e.g., '盈余公积')")
    amount: float = Field(description="The closing balance amount of the surplus reserve")
    currency: str = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g., '人民币元'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    statutory_reserve_records: list[StatutoryReserveRecord]
